name: 63601 · Park Hills, MO
findings: ZIP 63601 (Park Hills) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63601 (Park Hills) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
